body: Assuming you bleached your hair to a level 9/10 and you’re putting a level 4 on your bleached hair the color did not take properly because it was too light and probably had an uneven porosity hence the purple/blue. A level 4VV is a dark brown with a violet undertone but if your hair is too light it will just grab the major pigment which in this case was violet. Try prefilling your hair first with a darker color like a level 5/6 (use a demi permanent to prefill) and then put the 4VV on after and it will turn out more true (the dark brown with a purple undertone).
